10266|6e63d362.name: Ug'thok
10266|6e63d362.text: You learn quickly, that is not a bad thing. Just be sure to do the job right, as long as it takes to do so. Now, I fear I must send you to Snarl to learn more. Learn what he can teach, but do not listen to his angry words. He gets that way when Saru's daughters laugh at him.

10278|af34ad47.name: Thrag Stonehoof
10278|af34ad47.text: I guess the spirits like you better than me, I still have not heard their call but you seem to have gathered their lessons well. Go speak to Karn, he will be excited to see one who hears them as he does.

1383|38a0c930.name: Snarl
1383|38a0c930.text: There is nothing more that I can teach - now get out! And don't even think of approaching Saru, for one as unworthy as you he will use your blood to temper his steel.

2998|d12d69b6.name: Karn Stonehoof
2998|d12d69b6.text: You have learned much, but I sense that there is more left for the spirits to teach you. I can place your foot on the path but cannot guide your steps. Go and find Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar, the next stretch of your journey begins there.

1136-complete.name: Melor Stonehoof
1136-complete.text:
Both strength and cunning were needed to find and defeat Frostmaw, $N.  You have both.

Your path has taken you to the valleys of Thousand Needles and to the high mountains of Alterac.  It will one day lead you through all the Earthmother's lands, for such is the way of the hunter.
1136-complete.title: Frostmaw

1136-progress.name: Melor Stonehoof
1136-progress.text: Have you been to the Alterac Mountains, $N?  Did you face the elusive Frostmaw?
1136-progress.title: Frostmaw

1431-accept.name: Craven Drok
1431-accept.text:
Be still, $c, and allow me to share with you something important to our people, but far from obvious.

We are a proud race, and the war with the humans tried even Thrall's great patience. You see, our Warchief is wise and prudent, and he continues to put his people first. Ultimately, he is a diplomat, and in his time with the humans he learned much of their ways.

If the tale I've started piques your interest, then find Keldran near the western exit of the city. His hovel is there.
1431-accept.title: Alliance Relations

1431-complete.name: Keldran
1431-complete.text:
Putanni, noble $c. I am Keldran, student of magic... and other mystical arts.

The business Craven sent you here to speak to me about requires a touch more subtlety than you've previously needed, but that does not mean you can not still aid our cause.

Please, make yourself comfortable, and I shall tell you why the Warchief has need of my aid... and yours.

It starts with appearances, $N. How the Horde sees itself. How our allies see us. And most importantly, how our enemies see us.
1431-complete.title: Alliance Relations

509-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
509-complete.text: Ah, the horrible reek of Mudsnout Blossoms.  At least those filthy Gnolls are good for something.
509-complete.title: Elixir of Agony

513-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
513-accept.text:
Just when I thought another day was going to pass devoid of any joy, you brought me those marvelous Mudsnout Blossoms.

First I will mix them down into a fine composite.  We'll then need Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity to apply his colloid of decay to it and then we'll be ready for some good fun indeed!

Here, take this Mudsnout Composite and run it off to Master Faranell at once, $N.
513-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

513-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
513-complete.text:
Apothecary Lydon sent you?  Ah, why didn't you say so!

Despite his gloomy disposition, Apothecary Lydon is one of our most dedicated and skilled members.

The good chap sends Mudsnout Composite!  I know what our friend in Hillsbrad is up to now.  And I like the way he thinks.  The Dark Lady would be most impressed with the progress he is making toward the new plague.
513-complete.title: Elixir of Agony

513-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
513-progress.text: Can you not see I am busy, $c?  The Dark Lady insists on a new plague before the Scourge advance from Northrend overwhelms us.  And with the human threat pressing from the south, time becomes my most precious commodity.  This better be important!
513-progress.title: Elixir of Agony

515-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
515-accept.text:
A mudsnout composite?  Absolutely brilliant!  Why didn't I think of that?

Let me contribute my colloid of decay to this devilish brew.

In order to activate the contaminating agents in this mudsnout mixture, Lydon is going to need a strong troll's blood elixir, as well as some daggerspine scales and torn fin eyes from the southern coast of Hillsbrad.  He'll know what to do once you've gathered him all the reagents.  And my, how anxious I am to hear how his experiment goes!
515-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

553-accept.name: Novice Thaivand
553-accept.text:
Here, take the Rod of Helcular. You will need it.

Helcular fashioned 3 ceremonial pyres as part of his most powerful spell.  The Flame of Azel and the Flame of Veraz lie within the Foothill Caverns. The Flame of Uzel lies in a cave above the caverns, further north in the mountains.

The Rod of Helcular must be charged from each of the three flames. Once the ritual is complete, drive the rod into Helcular's grave in Southshore, the heavily guarded human town to the south.  Vengeance shall be ours!
553-accept.title: Helcular's Revenge

553-complete.name: Unknown
553-complete.text: A great rumbling emanates from the ground.
553-complete.title: Helcular's Revenge

553-progress.name: Unknown
553-progress.text: Helcular's grave teems with a mystical energy.
553-progress.title: Helcular's Revenge

95697-accept.name: Borstan
95697-accept.text:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?
95697-accept.title: Changing Tastes
